about_the_game:
Enjoy a unique "Jumpscare Simulator" experience that pushes fear and tension to their peak with this special Supporter Pack!

This Supporter Pack includes:

"Staring Contest" Game Mode
"You can't look away, and you definitely can't mute it."

Carefully listen to every sound and maintain your focus on your opponent's eyes. When the right moment comes, if you don't flip the switch fast enough, you'll face the consequences.

"Retro Prank" DLC
"Remember that terrifying woman who suddenly popped onto your screen when you were innocently concentrating as a child? And remember your friend who pulled that prank on you? Revenge is a dish best served cold..."

It looks like an innocent memory game, where you carefully follow and match lights of different colors on the screen. However, only you know about the secret keyboard shortcut. Quietly press it to activate the "prank" at the moment your victim is most focused. Tell your victim you can't pass this level, hand it over to them, and enjoy the perfect reaction!

(Perfect for digital setups—make sure you share both your screen and sound with your friend(s).)

"Tense Chat Night" DLC
"How long can you endure this uncertainty?"

Gather your friends for a relaxing evening, activate this game mode, and turn up the volume. Keep enjoying your time together accompanied by a cozy fireplace and peaceful music. However, be warned: Within as little as 5 minutes or as long as 1 hour, a sudden jumpscare will catch everyone completely off guard. Even I don't know exactly when it'll happen—that's the thrill of uncertainty. Enjoy the suspense!

By purchasing this DLC, you're not just maximizing your jumpscare experience—you're also directly supporting my solo development journey. Grab the Supporter Pack and help me shape the future of Jumpscare Simulator!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: Modern integrated or dedicated GPU (DirectX 12 or Vulkan support required)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for a smoother experience on low settings
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Ryzen 5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better (DirectX 12 or Vulkan support required)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for a smoother experience on low settings
